access_token.description: The bearer token. It is the same token the client login mints — only the envelope differs, because an RFC-compliant client parses this one and knows nothing about Fleetless.

token_type.description: `Bearer`. RFC 6749 §5.1 makes the value case-insensitive for a client reading it; this is the spelling this server emits.

expires_in.description: How long the access token is valid, in **seconds**, per RFC 6749 §5.1. Not a timestamp, and not milliseconds.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token, when one was issued. It rotates on every use.

scope.description: The scopes the issued token actually carries, space-separated.
